ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Operator decision 2026-10-08 (supersedes DO-NOT #25 no-updater rule): Dependabot version updates for github-actions ONLY in this repo (weekly, minor/patch grouped, 7-day cooldown, svenroth-ai/shipwright ignored); npm stays out; GitHub-owned actions keep mutable tags, third-party stay SHA-pinned; nothing shipped to adopters. ci.yml and pr-review-run.yml: comment-only changes.
